# `jouet pr status`

- **Usage:** `jouet pr status [FLAGS] [PRS]…`

Show where PRs stand and why any need attention

Prints one line per PR, then a summary. GitHub PRs are fetched in one batched GraphQL query; GitLab merge requests and Forgejo or Gitea PRs (named HOST/OWNER/NAME#N, by URL, or through a remote on that forge) are read through their REST APIs, and trails on Entire-hosted repositories (entire.com/PROJECT/NAME#N) through the `entire` CLI. Each PR lists fixed attention codes: conflict, checks_failing, checks_missing, changes_requested, unresolved_threads, entire_findings, entire_gates, behind_base, draft and mergeable_unknown.

A PR with an Entire Gates check gets a line saying which gate fails and why. The check is not counted as a failing check of its own: a failed checks gate repeats the checks above, an up-to-date gate is behind_base, and a findings gate is entire_findings, naming the open findings when the `entire` CLI is on PATH and logged in. Without it, `--json` says why under `entire`.

## Arguments
- **`[PRS]…`** — PRs as numbers, URLs, OWNER/REPO#N or branch names. Defaults to the current branch's PR

## Flags
- **`--mine`** — Add the open PRs authored by the token's user
- **`--search <QUERY>`** — Add the PRs matching a GitHub search query
- **`--repo <OWNER/NAME>`** — The repository for bare numbers, branches, --mine and --search. Repeatable. Defaults to the git remote
- **`--settle <DUR>`** — How long to wait for GitHub to compute an unknown mergeable state (default 20s; 0 disables)
- **`--fail-on-attention`** — Exit 1 when any PR needs attention
- **`-h --help`** — Print help
